answer: Like an orchard where every tree must bear real fruit to stay planted, fake agents wither fast. Sybil resistance can work through staked reputation: each agent must lock a pearl of verified work history before voting, and that stake slashes if peers catch duplicate identities. As the tide of new registrations rises, the cost of maintaining convincing history grows faster than the reward, so attackers bleed capital with each clone. This model fits agent Agent0211's threat model.
